summary_short.zh: shadPS4 是一款开源 PlayStation 4 模拟器，允许在 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 系统上运行 PS4 游戏，打破了主机与 PC 之间的平台壁垒。该项目采用现代 C++20 编写，并利用 Vulkan 图形 API 实现高效的跨平台渲染，展示了如何通过软件抽象层模拟专用硬件环境。其模块化设计为开发者提供了研究游戏机系统架构和低层优化的学习范例，而用户则可在其中安全地测试自制程序或探索游戏修改可能性，是理解现代游戏系统仿真的实用工具。

summaries.en: shadPS4 is an open-source PlayStation 4 emulator that enables running PS4 games on Windows, Linux, and macOS computers, making console-exclusive titles accessible on PC platforms. It's built with modern C++20 and leverages Vulkan graphics API for efficient cross-platform rendering, demonstrating how emulators can bridge hardware ecosystems through software abstraction. Developers can study its architecture to understand console emulation techniques, while users can experiment with running homebrew applications or exploring game modifications in a controlled environment.

summary_short.zh: Open-SWE 是一个开源异步编码代理，旨在通过分解复杂软件工程任务来帮助开发者实现自动化。其核心采用模块化架构，不同专业代理并行处理编码各阶段，支持迭代优化，这种设计显著提升了任务执行效率。开发者可通过 Python API 将其集成到工作流中，自动完成代码生成、调试或文档编写等任务，非常适合快速原型开发或加速项目迭代，为实际工程应用提供了灵活可靠的自动化解决方案。

summaries.en: Open-SWE is an open-source asynchronous coding agent that helps developers automate complex software engineering tasks by breaking them into manageable subtasks. It operates through a modular architecture where specialized agents handle different coding phases, enabling parallel execution and iterative refinement. Developers can integrate it into their workflows via its Python API to automate code generation, debugging, or documentation tasks, making it ideal for prototyping or accelerating development cycles.

summary_short.zh: Newton是一个基于NVIDIA Warp构建的开源GPU加速物理仿真引擎，专为机器人学和仿真研究设计。它通过Warp实现GPU并行化，能够实时处理复杂的多体动力学问题，让高保真仿真变得高效可行。该引擎采用模块化Python接口，研究人员可快速搭建机器人控制原型、测试抓取任务，或扩展自定义物理场景来开发新算法，为实验提供灵活可靠的仿真环境。

summaries.zh: Newton是一个基于NVIDIA Warp构建的开源GPU加速物理仿真引擎，专为机器人学和仿真研究设计。它通过Warp实现GPU并行化，能够实时处理复杂的多体动力学问题，让高保真仿真变得高效可行。该引擎采用模块化Python接口，研究人员可快速搭建机器人控制原型、测试抓取任务，或扩展自定义物理场景来开发新算法，为实验提供灵活可靠的仿真环境。
summaries.en: Newton is an open-source GPU-accelerated physics simulation engine built on NVIDIA Warp that enables realistic robotic and physics simulations. Its key innovation is leveraging GPU parallelization through Warp to achieve real-time performance for complex multi-body dynamics, making high-fidelity simulation accessible. Researchers can use it to prototype robotic controllers, test manipulation tasks, or develop new simulation algorithms by extending its modular Python API for custom physics scenarios.
